newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains at close in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains at close in dull market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka gained on poor dollar demand and closed at 42.5460/425475 to the dollar in a dull session of the interbank market against the previous close of 42.5470/5480, dealers said.

The local unit was quoted in a wide range at 42.5460/5490 per dollar in early trade but gained amid a poor turnout of importers. "Dollar was available basically due to declining import payments over the past two weeks. Banks are extending the LCs. This is typical during the year-end of banks," said a dealer. The interbank call money rates finished flat at six percent to 6.75 percent, dealers said.
